name: python-ring-buffer
title: Ring Buffer
blurb: A fixed-capacity FIFO over integers: the drain equals the reference deque exactly under drop-oldest, the cursor never leaves [0, capacity), a full ring overwrites exactly the oldest, and the walk from (head, count) is the visible sequence after every op.
default_description: A fixed-capacity FIFO over integers whose drain equals the deque exactly under the drop-oldest rule.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: the cursor never leaves the ring
